<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_sourcelists_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">source<wbr>Lists</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Source list of the rule, it can be a set of ip sources or a set of domain sources. The number of items ranges from 1 to 16.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_sourcetype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_sourcetype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">source<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Source type, <code>1</code> for source of host, <code>2</code> for source of IP.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_sslid_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_sslid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ssl<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>SSL ID, when the <code>protocol</code> is <code>https</code>, the field should be set with valid SSL id.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_status_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_status_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">status</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Status of the rule. <code>0</code> for create/modify success, <code>2</code> for create/modify fail, <code>3</code> for delete success, <code>5</code> for delete failed, <code>6</code> for waiting to be created/modified, <code>7</code> for waiting to be deleted and 8 for waiting to get SSL ID.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_switch_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_switch_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">switch</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicate the rule will take effect or not.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>
